# exo_access_to_customer_data_request (Data Source)

Look up an existing AccessToCustomerDataRequest object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `approval_decision` (String) Maps to the -ApprovalDecision parameter.
- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `request_id` (String) Maps to the -RequestId parameter.
- `service_name` (String) Maps to the -ServiceName parameter.
